name: Isuwari Kanojo to no Doki Doki Doukyo Seikatsu ~Nee Nee, Oji-san Shitai Desho♪~
original_name: 居座りカノジョとのドキドキ同居生活 ～ねぇねぇ、おじさんしたいでしょ♪～
source:
"A brief and ephemeral life, felt like it......"

Hit by a sudden rain at night, Gouda walks into a park that he does not usually pass as a shortcut.

He has to work overtime everyday, so he always returns home late at night.

Even though he wants to change job, he does not have enough achievement or qualifications to do so. In addition to being soaking wet, he just want to rest as soon as possible.

It is at this time that he meets a runaway girl Kamae Mitsumi.

Unwillingly, he takes her in for one night. However, he later lets her stay with him――

Thus, a peculiar cohabitation life begins.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1232407]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
“短暂而短暂的一生，感觉就像……”

夜里突如其来的一场雨，高达走进了一个他平时不走捷径的公园。

他每天都要加班，所以总是很晚才回家。

尽管他想换工作，但他没有足够的成就或资历。除了浑身湿透，他只想尽快休息。

就在这个时候，他遇到了离家出走的女孩龟江美美。

他不情愿地收留了她一晚。然而，后来他让她留在自己身边——

于是，一段奇特的同居生活开始了。

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1232407]Getchu[/url]]
